# ui::PickFolderOptions

Header: `winui/ui/Pickers.hpp`.

What [pick_folder()](namespace-ui.md#pick_folder) and [pick_folders()](namespace-ui.md#pick_folders) are asked for. Every field is optional.

Example: 
```cpp
if (auto folder = ui::pick_folder(window, {.title = "Choose a library"}))
{
    window.set_title(ui::path_to_utf8(folder->filename()));
}
```

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `std::string` |  | The dialog caption; empty keeps the default. |
| `commit_button_text` | `std::string` |  | The Select button's label; empty keeps the default. |
| `start_location` | `PickerLocation` | `PickerLocation::Unspecified` | The known folder to open in when `folder` is empty. |
| `folder` | `std::filesystem::path` |  | The folder to open in, if it exists; absolute. Wins over `start_location`. |
| `remember_last` | `bool` | `true` | True: `folder` (or `start_location`) opens the first time, and after that the dialog reopens wherever the user last picked from. False: it opens every time. |
